outlet: VoteWA election results, Adams County, August 4, 2026 primary
notes: Adams County primary results (fully reported, as of 2026-09-11): Assessor Templin 1,295, Rodriguez 1,039; Auditor Laird 1,060, Fannin 646, Dormaier 576; Sheriff Wagner 1,329, Carlson 1,060; County Commissioner District 3 counted in 5 of 30 reporting units (Garza 334, Brodahl 227); every other county office in 30 of 30. Park and Recreation District No. 2 Prop. 1: Approved 70, Rejected 52 (57.4%); Park District 3: 160-101; Park District 4: 520-304; Cemetery District 1: 91-31.
